newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets 12-day repo tender fixed at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets 12-day repo tender fixed at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it was setting a tender for 12-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed rate of three percent.

The result of the auction will be announced on Wednesday and funds will be credited to accounts on Thursday, when portions of the Bundesbank's annual profit will also flow into the system. The securities have to be repurchased on April 29.

A 69 billion mark facility set also at a fixed three percent rate expires on Wednesday. A 14-day facility set last week carried a three percent interest rate, the rate that has prevailed since late August.
